lead.headline: Tuten should play — put him back; Wilson likely out
lead.deck: Fowler reverses the morning's Tuten call; Wilson missed a second practice; Murray out, Wentz to Jefferson.
lead.body: The bad news first. Garrett Wilson missed Thursday's practice as well, still in the concussion protocol, and ESPN's Rich Cimini calls a Week 9 return unlikely. Alvin Kamara was only limited with his back. Kyler Murray is out Monday, so Carson Wentz throws to Justin Jefferson. The better news undoes this morning's call: ESPN's Jeremy Fowler reported at about 15:50 that Bhayshul Tuten should play at Baltimore tonight. Put Tuten back in the RB slot before the 19:15 kickoff, move Kamara into Wilson's FLEX slot, and check the 17:45 inactive list.

doFirst.headline: Tuten back in before 19:15; Kamara to the FLEX
doFirst.deck: Start Tuten over Kamara and Kamara over Wilson tonight; check the 17:45 list, then Sunday 10:30.
doFirst.note: The Tuten swap and the Wilson swap are on the brief's Do-first; the cards here are the fallbacks. Free agents are open; nothing on the wire beats a starter.
doFirst.empty: Nothing to do but tonight's two swaps.

cards.reason: Limited Thursday with his back; Friday's report decides.
